jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image: existing side-view walking/jumping courier identity and materials; it is a reference for identity, not a required arrangement. Create a production GAME SPRITESHEET of that same mint-green acorn courier with amber goggles, layered green leaf cap/scarf, oversized golden spring boots. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. EXACTLY TWO columns and FOUR rows =8 individual sprites. Column1 faces EAST (screen right); column2 faces WEST (screen left). Rows are four successive run/jump animation poses. Both are actual side views. This is actual character/vehicle turnaround, not rotation of a flat picture. Keep the fixed overhead/isometric 2.5D camera and upper-left light in every cell; turn the subject around its world vertical axis. Head/feet/body remain upright on screen, do NOT tumble or rotate sprites in the picture plane. South shows front, North shows back surfaces and no front face; East/West show corresponding side views. For the moth, kite and swallow, direction is the subject's nose/face/travel bearing, with coherent visible top surfaces and wing flex; no mirrored pasted lighting. For upright creatures feet remain below heads at every bearing. Preserve exact colors, features, proportions and polished hand-painted arcade style of the reference. Same fixed scale for all poses, generous transparent margins around EACH FULL sprite. Strict equal cell grid and isolated silhouettes; no touching/overlapping cells, no cropped antennae/scarves/wings. NO text, letters, labels, borders, ground, diagrams, shadows outside sprite or extra objects. Readable at44px.
